name: The Mentor
fieldReading: Hold the door open behind you.
bio: The one who holds the door open behind them — welcoming the hesitant in as if they'd always belonged.
sceneStory: In the middle of an empty dark field stands a single freestanding door, warm light pouring out around its edges. Beside it a figure hung with a hundred keys holds one out to a hesitant newcomer just stepping in from the dark.
assignment: See the one still outside the light, and wave them in. Someone once did it for you.
